title: Screen Apnea - Thermal-Based Sleep Apnea Detection
description: An AI-powered computer vision system for non-contact sleep apnea detection using thermal imaging. The project detects the nostril region using YOLO, extracts respiratory signals from thermal videos, and estimates breathing patterns for apnea event analysis.

title: Real-Time Surveillance Alert System with Vision Language Model
description: An intelligent surveillance system that combines YOLOv8 object detection with Vision Language Models (VLMs) to detect weapons, suspicious activities, and generate contextual alerts in real time. The system is designed for offline deployment and smart surveillance applications.

title: Arduino Nano + ESP01 IoT Dashboard
description: A Blynk-inspired IoT platform built from scratch using Arduino Nano and ESP-01. The project supports real-time monitoring and control of sensors and actuators through a custom web dashboard using HTTP, WebSocket, and MQTT communication.

title: Bahikhata - Digital Record Keeping Platform
description: A platform to modernize record-keeping for due payments, replacing traditional pen-and-paper methods with a digital solution featuring role-based access control.

title: LILY - Smart Desk Assistant
description: A smart desk assistant integrating NLP, task automation, and interactive features using OpenAI API and Wikipedia API for intelligent responses.
